00046 VoicerBaseUGenInternal::VoicerBaseUGenInternal(const int numChannels, const int numVoices, const bool forcedSteal) throw()
00047 :   SpawnBaseUGenInternal(0, numChannels, 0),
00048     numVoices_(numVoices),
00049     stealMode_(StealOldest),
00050     forcedSteal_(forcedSteal),
00051     ageCounter(0)

00053 }
00054 
00055 void VoicerBaseUGenInternal::sendMidiNote(const int midiChannel, 
00056                                           const int midiNote,
00057                                           const int velocity) throw()
00058 {
00059     const int userData = createUserData(midiChannel, midiNote);
00060     
00061     // could assert if userData==UGen::defaultUserData or if testUserData() is true?
00062     
00063     if(velocity > 0)
00064     {
00065         if(numVoices_ > 0)
00066         {
00067             //const int voicesUsed = events.countTestedUserData(this, false);
00068             const int voicesUsed = countNonstealingVoices();
00069             if(voicesUsed >= numVoices_)
00070             {
00071                 UGen& stealee = chooseStealee();
00072                     
00073                 if(stealee.isNotNull())
00074                 {
00075                     stealee.userData = stealingUserData;
00076                     stealee.steal(forcedSteal_);
00077                 }
00078             }
00079         }
00080         
00081         // stop double notes, AU lab was sending two ons but only one off 
00082         stealNote(midiChannel, midiNote, false, true); 
00083         
00084         UGen newEvent = spawnEvent(*this, currentEventIndex++, midiChannel, midiNote, velocity);
00085         newEvent.userData = userData;
00086         events <<= newEvent;
00087         mixer = Mix(&events, false);
00088     }
00089     else
00090     {
00091         UGen& releasee = chooseReleasee(midiChannel, midiNote);
00092         
00093         if(releasee.isNotNull())
00094         {
00095             //releasee.userData = UGen::defaultUserData; // need to rethink why I really wanted to do this
00096             releasee.release();
00097         }
00098     }
00099 }

00101 bool VoicerBaseUGenInternal::stealNote(const int midiChannel, 
00102                                        const int midiNote, 
00103                                        const bool forcedSteal,
00104                                        const bool stealAll) throw()
00105 {
00106     const int userData = createUserData(midiChannel, midiNote);
00107     bool didSteal = false;
00108     
00109     for(int i = 0; i < events.size(); i++)
00110     {
00111         UGen& event = events[i];
00112         if(event.userData == userData)
00113         {
00114             event.userData = stealingUserData;
00115             event.steal(forcedSteal);
00116             if(stealAll)
00117                 didSteal = true;
00118             else
00119                 return true;
00120         }
00121     }
00122     
00123     return didSteal;
00124 }

00126 int VoicerBaseUGenInternal::countNonstealingVoices() const throw()
00127 {
00128     const int numEvents = events.size();
00129     int nonStealingVoices = 0;
00130     
00131     for(int i = 0; i < numEvents; i++)
00132     {
00133         if(events[i].userData != stealingUserData)
00134             nonStealingVoices++;
00135     }
00136     
00137     return nonStealingVoices;
00138 }

00140 UGen& VoicerBaseUGenInternal::chooseStealee() throw()
00141 {
00142     // could use different methods in here to select the voice to steal
00143     
00144     const int numEvents = events.size();
00145     
00146     for(int i = 0; i < numEvents; i++)
00147     {
00148         UGen& stealee = events[i];
00149         if(stealee.userData != stealingUserData && stealee.isNotNull())
00150             return stealee;
00151     }
00152     
00153     return UGen::null;
00154 }

00156 UGen& VoicerBaseUGenInternal::chooseReleasee(const int midiChannel, const int midiNote) throw()
00157 {
00158     const int numEvents = events.size();
00159     
00160     for(int i = numEvents-1; i >= 0; i--) // release in reverse ?
00161     {
00162         UGen& releasee = events[i];
00163         VoicerUserDataStruct data = getUserData(releasee.userData);
00164         if((data.midiChannel == midiChannel)
00165            && (data.midiNote == midiNote) 
00166            // && (releasee.isReleasing() == false // something like this would be useful but tricky to implement
00167            )
00168         {
00169             return releasee;
00170         }
00171     }
00172     
00173     return UGen::null;
00174 }
